issue_context.body:

**Link to the GitHub repository with the repro**

https://github.com/Marcin3/challenge

or

**Config file**

```js
// playwright.config.ts
import type { PlaywrightTestConfig } from "@playwright/test";
import { devices } from "@playwright/test";
import dotenv from "dotenv";

dotenv.config();

const config: PlaywrightTestConfig = {
  testDir: "./tests",
  /* Maximum time one test can run for. */
  timeout: 30 * 1000,
  expect: {
    /**
     * Maximum time expect() should wait for the condition to be met.
     * For example in `await expect(locator).toHaveText();`
     */
    timeout: 10000,
  },
  fullyParallel: true,
  forbidOnly: !!process.env.CI,
  retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 0,
  workers: 2,
  reporter: "html",

  use: {
    actionTimeout: 0,
    baseURL: process.env.BASE_URL,

    /* Collect trace when retrying the failed test. See https://playwright.dev/docs/trace-viewer */
    trace: "on",
  },

  /* Configure projects for major browsers */
  projects: [
    {
      name: "chromium",
      use: {
        ...devices["Desktop Chrome"],
      },
    },
  ],
};

export default config;

```

**Test file (self-contained)**

```ts
test("Search wrong word", async ({ page }) => {
  const wrongWord = "sythetic";
  const mainMenuPage = new MainMenuPage(page);

  await test.step(`Given User is on page https://mostly.ai/`, async () => {
    await page.goto("");
    expect(page).toHaveURL("");
  });

  await test.step(`When User click the “Search” button`, async () => {
    await mainMenuPage.clickOnSearchButton();
  });

  await test.step(`And type “sythetic” (wrong spelling of synthetic) in search field`, async () => {
    await mainMenuPage.fillSearchFiled(wrongWord);
  });

  await test.step(`And press Enter`, async () => {
    await mainMenuPage.pressEnterButtonOnSearchFiled();
  });

  await test.step(`Then User can see following information: “Sorry, no results for: sythetic”`, async () => {
    const firstPart = `Sorry, no results for:`;
    await mainMenuPage.checkSearchResult(firstPart, wrongWord);
  });
});
```

**Steps**
- Clone the repo
- First install project using command ` npm install`
- To run tests please run from root using command `npx playwright test`
- Open report  npx playwright show-report

**Expected**

For test Search wrong word you should see step When User click the “Search” button

**Actual**
Now this step is missing 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10815386/223079904-9edf7ce4-5774-4a5c-96dd-ddfcf59f55d9.png)

Here is also link to playwright report https://github.com/Marcin3/challenge/tree/main/playwright-report
comments: You have a missing await in `expect(page).toHaveURL("");` -> `await expect(page).toHaveURL("");` which should fix it.
We will most likely implement a best effort workaround to handle such case thats why I assigned it.
We can improve step nesting by using zones.

I have the problem of not all `test.step()` messages showing in the HTML Report output... > You have a missing await in `expect(page).toHaveURL("");` -> `await expect(page).toHaveURL("");` which should fix it. This doesn't seem to be the issue for me... I don't have any missing necessary awaits in my specific tests and adding `await` on all `expect()` calls throughout my entire test framework codebase (just as a test) did NOT resolve the problem for me. Fortunately, it does appear that the steps missing from the HTML Report output **are** being executed based on the test outcome and the video recorded by Playwright which shows the actions.

review_comments: testInfo._runAsStep will call step.complete({}) again, is that expected?
This comment suggests that running `beforeEach` from `test` in separate `runFn()` calls will break "skip inside beforeEach" scenario. I guess we are missing a test for this!
